title: geckolib issue #775: Armor with new geoBones render w/ all armor pieces instead of one
licence: GitHub issue thread: user-generated content under the GitHub Terms of Service; the repo licence (MIT) does not cover issue text
text: [issue by WenXin20] ``` Minecraft v1.21.1 Noeforge v21.1.205 Geckolib v4.8.2 ``` I have coded the leggings to render with `armorWaist` and `armorDress`. It renders correctly when equipped on non-geckolib mobs, but when equipped by a geckolib mob, the `armorWaist `will render with each armor piece, even if only the hat is worn. The items used in the images are named `marioverse:mario_hat` and `marioverse:mario_pants` Armor Renderer: https://github.com/WenXin20/Marioverse/blob/1.21/src/main/java/com/wenxin2/marioverse/client/renderers/costumes/CostumeRenderer.java Mob Renderer: https://github.com/WenXin20/Marioverse/blob/1.21/src/main/java/com/wenxin2/marioverse/client/renderers/entities/GoombaRenderer.java Armor stand w/ leggings - goomba `armorWaist` appears If the mob can wear multiple armor pieces, it renders `armorWaist` for each piece worn [comment by Tslat (collaborator)] It looks like you're setting the dress bone visible if the humanoidmodel's body is visible https://github.com/WenXin20/Marioverse/blob/90d60422ebc1bbd8c725c94f182e6d505effa4a4/src/main/java/com/wenxin2/marioverse/client/renderers/costumes/CostumeRenderer.java#L121 You should only be setting it by slot in that method override applyBoneVisibilityByPart if you need to do part-based visibility [comment by Tslat (collaborator)] Going to close this until the above resolution is looked at
